bio: Set in the heart of Dartmoor National Park, The Two Bridges Hotel and Tor Restaurant marry vibrant surroundings with relaxing countryside. Enjoy the Afternoon Tea alongside a crackling log fire, with stunning views of the surrounding Dartmoor countryside in the hotel. During the summer, guests can enjoy the terrace and riverside gardens. Treat yourself to a selection of sandwiches, home baked scone served with Hogs Bottom strawberry jam and home-made cakes all served with a pot of tea of cafetiere of coffee. If you're feeling extra indulgent, why not add a glass of Prosecco? Located in the heart of Dartmoor National Park, The Two Bridges Hotel is 15 minutes' drive to Tavistock.
